hook: Mehrotra built Allstate's entire AI Center of Excellence from the ground up, an 80-plus person team and a multi-year generative AI strategy, and now applies that same enterprise-AI playbook as Chief AI Officer at U.S. Bank.
name: Prashant Mehrotra

quote.text: Created and executing a multi-year AI strategy for Allstate that takes advantage of new Generative AI innovation to establish a market leading position for Allstate in the Insurance sector.
quote.context: Prashant Mehrotra, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief AI Officer at U.S. Bank

timeline.impact: Leads global data warehouse and CRM platform delivery across 14 countries

timeline.event: Joins Capital One as Director of Data Engineering
Joins Allstate to build the AI Center of Excellence
timeline.impact: Begins six-year build of enterprise AI strategy and platform

timeline.event: Named EVP and Chief AI Officer at U.S. Bank
timeline.impact: Leads AI strategy at a major national bank

quick_facts: EVP and Chief AI Officer at U.S. Bank
Built Allstate's AI Center of Excellence and its enterprise Generative AI platform
Previously led data engineering at Capital One, migrating the Card division to cloud infrastructure
Bachelor of Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi

achievements.title: Founding and leading Allstate's AI Center of Excellence (2018-2024)
achievements.impact: Built and led an 80+ member team executing a multi-year AI strategy, launching an enterprise Generative AI platform compliant with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, generating multi-million-dollar annual cost savings.

achievements.title: Named EVP and Chief AI Officer, U.S. Bank (2024)
achievements.impact: Leads AI strategy at one of the largest U.S. financial institutions.

achievements.title: Applying AI to unstructured data at Allstate
achievements.impact: Used AI to analyze petabytes of voice, image, and document data, opening new revenue streams and reducing compliance costs.

achievements.title: Director of Data Engineering, Capital One
achievements.impact: Directed the Card division's migration of analytics infrastructure to cloud-based big data systems, integrating seven merchant partners and reducing operational costs.
